name: zt-econ-digest
description: Digest a Chinese-translated economics book into ZET Cards: the ZT digest base with the economics set: the model layer (Model Cards in the digest, the model compiler with the economic architect), the event layer (Event Cards from the book's dated sentences), the empirical-results layer (Finding Cards, one per result), and the economics prompts; it builds only the Literature tree (Topic trees, hubs and the register are zt-idea-grow's)
whenToUse: Turn a Scholar Archive economics book (Chinese bilingual Markdown, digested as Chinese only) into an agent Literature tree with Idea, Event, Finding, and Model Cards (economic models at concept or formal level). It writes no Topic tree, no Hub Card and no register: zt-idea-grow grows those from the Literature trees afterwards. Modes link, models, cards, explain, events, findings, figures, audit and bridge re-run single stages on an existing digest.

preflight.P1: Goal and result: the book digest of the removed zt-book-digest.js for economics books, on the framework, with the economics layers as its own module set. The result is the base result with the model reports, events: {...}, and findings: {...}. The base 2.1.2 adds the Bridge report and isolated apply mode.
preflight.P2: Inputs: the base args plus events and findings (false skips that layer). Base Bridge arguments are inherited; base 2.4.0 adds args.book, the Scholar Archive Work id or title that resolves the book.
preflight.P3: Units of work: as the base, plus the Model Cards of the book (model layer), the dated sentences per group (event layer), and the sentences that report data with a number per group (empirical-results layer; 3 groups per DeepSeek job each).
preflight.P4: Roles: as the base (manager Haiku low, architect Sonnet, organizer Opus).
preflight.P5: Stage graph: args → source → prepare → [after-prepare] → terms → digest → cards → [after-digest: models] → [after-models: explain] → cards-book → link-prepare → link → link-check → [after-link] → organize → figures → bridge → audit → finalize → cleanup → report. 6.0.0 (base 5.0.0, docs/literature-only-digest-design.md): the digest builds only the book's Literature tree; the concept review, the restatement review, the hubs and the register plan left the run, and zt-idea-grow composes the Topic trees, the hubs and the register later. The Event and Finding layers fill after-terms, so they are worked from ledger readiness while the remaining digest groups run, and they file each Event and Finding Card beside the Literature Idea Cards it supports; after-digest: the model layer, released when the digest managers settle; after-models: explanations of the finished Derivation parts, which settle before the link pass; the whole-book card cycle waits for the Model reviews; then Figures → Bridge (Literature trees only) and the final audit. Bridge profile book. A resume and the repair modes drain the tail that their own layer released: modes models, explain, events and findings run their layer, the changed-Card Link pass and check, Organize, the audit and the settlement, and mode resume adds the finalization (#87, R283/R286).
preflight.P6: Modules (the economics set): the profile (dsh-digest-base.zh.md plus dsh-model-cards.zh.md: the digest writes Idea Cards and Model Cards; shared-prefix.md, link-prefix.md; the economic architect model-architect.md), zt-model-layer and zt-explain (zt-model-lib), zt-event-layer (event-compiler.ps1, dsh-event-instructions.zh.md), zt-finding-layer (finding-compiler.ps1, dsh-finding-instructions.zh.md; the Card type finding of zt 0.20.0). zt-bridge v3.
preflight.P7: Checks: as the base; each event and finding job runs its SELF-CHECK (precheck: fields, supported Cards, and zt-check on the drafts: E1, E2 or F1 to F3, and the Card language); apply refuses what the precheck reports; in mode full the link check card cycle then checks every Card of the book. Bridge BR1–BR9, exact report acceptance and guarded edits.
preflight.P8: Failure policy: as the base; the model layer halts only in mode models; the event and finding layers report refused items and go on. Modes: the base modes plus models, explain, events, findings. Bridge failure is nonfatal in full; bridge apply runs only args, Bridge and report. Mode resume accepts only out and spends the one supported resume; the repair modes keep their own layers and drain their dependent outputs instead of rebuilding unrelated groups or models (#87, R286).
preflight.P9: Dry run: zt-econ-digest.sim.json. Fixture: tests/framework-harness.mjs checks the readiness graph, the ledger commands of the group cycle and every layer, the runner restrictions and the joins on the built script; tests/event-compiler.tests.ps1 and tests/finding-compiler.tests.ps1 use scratch archives. Run with zt 0.20.0 deployed. Pilot: one chapter after a database backup. 4.4.1: rebuilt with the DeepSeek Subagent Managed Protocol v1.1 block (2026-10-18: managers start runs with wait_seconds 0, poll all open sessions, collect and delete at once, block on one session for at most pollSeconds, cancel after budgetMinutes); no stage, data-flow, param or role change. 5.11.0: built on the base 4.11.0 Tree Lock seam (zt-digest-lib v31, zt-digest-prepare v10), so preparation and every writing stage stop with the archive's typed `card_locked` refusal and keep their drafts and receipts (#140). 6.0.1 (base 5.0.1, zt-digest-lib v32): every approval rule that lets a DeepSeek job run the zt helper refuses a helper command with -Open, which would leave the Literature scope; no stage, data-flow, param or role change. 6.1.0: base 5.1.0 (the report names the zt-idea-grow follow-up; the hub leftovers are gone).

manager.description: Haiku: relays one script command, runs DeepSeek managers and clean-ups

architect.description: Sonnet: the model architect, writes plan.json only

organizer.description: Opus: the Organize decisions, writes decisions.json only

citationKey.description: the book's BibTeX key (all modes but audit)

source.description: the book's Chinese or bilingual Markdown (mode full)

book.description: a Scholar Archive Work id or an exact title: mode full resolves the Work, its Chinese/bilingual Markdown, the BibTeX and the heading range instead of source, bibtex and bookTitle

fileId.description: the book Markdown's Scholar Archive file id

startHeading.description: the Chinese heading where the digested text starts

endHeading.description: the Chinese heading where the digested text stops

skipHeadings.description: headings whose units are left out, e.g. 参考文献,习题

groups.description: the existing group count (modes link and models)

organize.description: true: Organize after modes link and models (the Literature index, the structure Card and the notes on the book's own Cards)

perManager.description: digest groups per Haiku manager (default 5, at most 8)

maxChars.description: the most characters of a group (default 20000)

maxUnits.description: the most units of a group (default 3)

dshSource.description: where DeepSeek V4.1 Flash runs; auto probes official, then OpenCode Go

dshModel.description: a DeepSeek Harness model that overrides dshSource

dshEffort.description: DeepSeek effort of digest, link, and fill runs (raised to high)

rebuild.description: rebuild models that already have parts

dshPerBatch.description: DeepSeek runs one Haiku manager keeps going (default 8, at most 8)

dshManagers.description: Haiku managers of one compiler step in parallel (default 8, at most 8)

linkPerManager.description: link runs one Haiku manager starts at once (default 8)

applyShare.description: jobs one card-cycle apply call writes (default 30)

only.description: the Model Card addresses to work on (a pilot)

level.description: build every model of the run to this level

briefEffort.description: DeepSeek effort of the briefs (raised to high)

deriveEffort.description: DeepSeek effort of the Derivation parts (raised to high)

reviewEffort.description: DeepSeek effort of the review (raised to high)

maxSentences.description: Card size of a formal model part: sentences (default 12)

maxPartChars.description: Card size of a formal model part: characters (default 400)

terms.description: mode full: false skips the book term table

audit.description: mode full: false skips the audit

finalize.description: mode full: false skips the finite finalization branch (audit plan, one scoped correction cycle, publication refresh, final read-only audit)

figures.description: mode full: false skips the Figures stage

cardChecks.description: modes full and link: false skips the card layer cycle

ideaSample.description: share of fault-free Idea Cards reviewed against the source (mode full: 0.1)

cardRules.description: the rules the card cycle fixes (default all hard rules)

cardMax.description: a pilot: at most this many Cards with faults and orphans

explainMax.description: mode explain, a pilot: at most this many Derivation parts

bridge.description: full mode: false skips Bridge discovery

bridgeCandidates.description: similarity candidates per source, default 5 plus at most two literal matches

bridgeReport.description: exact published report id; only mode bridge

bridgeApply.description: all or a unique array of new-carrier ids from bridgeReport

bridgeApplyEarlier.description: separate all or unique array of earlier-carrier ids from bridgeReport

maxAttempts.description: the per-unit attempt budget of the managed run (default 3); persisted at preparation

dshRunCap.description: the seconds one external DeepSeek run may live (default 1200); persisted at preparation

events.description: mode full: false skips the event layer

findings.description: mode full: false skips the empirical-results layer

stages.title: Prepare
stages.detail: the required args per mode

checks.message: args must be an object with citationKey
mode full needs args book, or args source, bibtex, and bookTitle
Bridge acceptance requires mode bridge, a report id, and a nonempty selection
bridgeMax must be a whole number in 1..120
bridgeCandidates must be a whole number in 1..8

mode resume reads the retained identity, source, Citation key, enabled layers and settings from its ledger and accepts only out: a new identity, source, group count, model list or Bridge selection needs its own preparation

stages.title: Prepare
stages.detail: the DeepSeek source (probe official, then OpenCode Go)

stages.title: Prepare
stages.detail: Chinese-only book text, section groups, the Literature tree with anchors, the shared prefixes

stages.title: Prepare
stages.detail: the book term table (book-terms.ps1 and one DeepSeek job)

stages.title: Events
stages.detail: the event layer: event-compiler.ps1 lists the dated sentences and each group's Idea Cards; DeepSeek writes the Event Cards as JSON with its SELF-CHECK; the script creates them beside the Idea Cards they support and links them

stages.title: Findings
stages.detail: the empirical-results layer: finding-compiler.ps1 lists the sentences that report data with a number and each group's Idea Cards; DeepSeek writes one Finding Card per result as JSON with its SELF-CHECK (F1 to F3); the script creates them beside the group anchors and links them with 印证

stages.title: Digest
stages.detail: the group cycle in blocks: one manager claims up to 8 digest/gNNN@1 units, a snapshot and frozen job per group, their DeepSeek runs side by side, each conversation recorded and deleted by that manager, checked group-finish (R250/R252/R253); at most 8 lanes

stages.title: Cards
stages.detail: the per-group offline Card checks (cards/gNNN@1), claimed from the ready work and recorded by cards-finish

stages.title: Models
stages.detail: the model layer: the model compiler on every Model Card of the book (DeepSeek brief → Sonnet plan → DeepSeek fill, derive, review, split)

stages.title: Models
stages.detail: mode explain: 思路, 说明, and 解读 for finished Derivation parts

stages.title: Cards
stages.detail: one whole-book card cycle after the digest runs (mode full), or on its own (mode cards); it also reviews the source of every Model draft no model chain elaborates

stages.title: Link
stages.detail: prepare-link-pass.ps1: the receipt-owned semantic gap set and the scheduled, gap-free and blocked groups

stages.title: Link
stages.detail: DeepSeek Link runs fill only the receipt-owned semantic gaps

stages.title: Cards
stages.detail: the card layer cycle on the new Links and the orphans

stages.title: Organize
stages.detail: survey → Opus thesis and notes (decisions.json) → apply (no merge, no move) → notes card cycle → skeleton (the Literature index and the structure Card)

stages.title: Figures
stages.detail: attach-figures.ps1: the book's own figures in the Cards that name them

stages.title: Bridge
stages.detail: bounded frozen cross-book discovery and immutable review report; explicit accepted apply in bridge mode

stages.title: Audit
stages.detail: digest-audit.ps1, read-only: faults per rule, orphans, models, figures (it counts the box's Topic trees and hubs as information, never as a digest fault)

stages.title: Finalize
stages.detail: the finite finalization: the audit plan, at most one compiler correction cycle scoped to its Cards, the changed-Card/touched-tree manifest, the dependency-scoped publication refresh, and the final read-only audit

stages.title: Cleanup
stages.detail: settle every DeepSeek conversation and workspace the run recorded, delete exactly those ids, remove only registered scratch inside the staging root, then render the verified run report (completeness, gaps, current placeholders, timings, exact per-run usage), reporting content_complete apart from cleanup_complete

stages.title: Report
stages.detail: the run's result per mode
